In Q4 2025, Airbnb reported revenue of $2.8 billion, reflecting a 12% increase year-over-year, driven by strong demand and effective product updates [2, 5]. The company achieved an adjusted EBITDA of $786 million, underscoring robust operational performance during the quarter [2].
